div.head: Ger 2
div.ab: [2] Hede se ðe scire healde, þæt he friðige 7 forðige ælce be ðam ðe hit selest sy; 7 be ðam he eac mot, ðe hine weder wisað.
Hede se ðe scire healde þæt he friðige 7 forðige ælce be ðam ðe hit se lest sy . 7 be ðam he eac mot ðe hine weder wisað .
The one who would oversee a shire must take heed that he promotes and furthers each [duty] as it should be attended to, and for that he must be guided by the weather.
Beobachte wer das Amt [der Gutsverwaltung] innehat, dass er schütze und fördere jede gemäss dem, wie es am besten sei; und auch gemäss dem muss er [es], wie ihn das Wetter anweist.
Let him who holds the office [of estate management] see to it that he protects and furthers each [task] in the way that is best; and also he must [do it] according to what the weather directs him.
div.note: ‘friðige ⁊ forðige’ is an alliterating pair. Liebermann compares Rect 4.6.
